description: This file contains functions for checking, copying, and upgrading disk images and partitions, specifically related to device upgrade procedures in a Linux environment, tailored for embedded or device firmware updates.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Checks if the disk image's partition layout has changed, and prompts for approval if so.

methods.name: platform_copy_config
methods.description: Copies backup configuration files to the target partition, mounting it as needed.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs a disk upgrade by writing image data to the device, handling partition table changes, and updating UUIDs.
